XTEINK’s Halloween sale includes a $69 X3 and X4 Classic extras

VN
By Vincent Nguyen October 21, 2026 · 5 min read
If you buy something from a link in this article, we may earn a commission. Learn more
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 5:16
Instaread

XTEINK's Halloween sale starts October 21 with extras for the X4 Classic, followed by an October 24–31 promotion for the X3 and X4 Classic, including the $69 X3. If you want a small reading screen instead of another tablet, the choice comes down to size, buttons and whether you read after dark.

The X3 is the smallest at 3.7 inches. The X4 Classic gives you a 4.3-inch screen and a free Base Stand, while the X4 Pro adds touch controls and a front light. Discounts reach up to 17% on selected e-readers, not every model or bundle.

Prices are in US dollars, before tax and shipping.

XTEINK X3: $69; October 24–31 campaign offer. Halloween case choice.
Where to buy: XTEINK X3

XTEINK X4 Classic: $65.57 with 17% code Halloween on eligible $79 configurations; October 21–23 early-bird stand and case bundles.
Where to buy: XTEINK X4 Classic

XTEINK X4 Pro: $99 regular price; not part of the Halloween promotion. Mist Gray preorder shipping expected from October 28.
Where to buy: XTEINK X4 Pro
Price checked: October 21, 2026.

A first look at our X3 and X4 Classic

I've just unboxed the X3 and X4 Classic. Both feel very light and compact, and the screens look clear. My first impression is that they're a great deal for the price.

Our package also included a screen protector. The X3 comes with a Pogo Pin charging cable. The X4 Classic comes with a Pogo Pin charging adapter (connector), which connects to a USB-C cable. Our Classic package did not include a USB-C cable. Neither reader came with a wall plug. The Base Stand itself doesn't charge the reader, and I'm fine with that.

X3: the smallest option

XTEINK X3: $69; October 24–31 campaign offer. Halloween case choice.
Where to buy: XTEINK X3
Price checked: October 21, 2026.

The X3 weighs roughly 58 grams and is 5.1mm thick. Both models fit comfortably; choosing between the X3's smaller size and the Classic's larger screen comes down to preference. Its 3.7-inch E Ink display leaves less room on each page, but physical buttons let you turn pages without touching the screen. A magnetic back attaches to a compatible surface.

An included 16GB microSD card holds your books, with support for cards up to 256GB. There's no built-in front light, so you'll need a lamp or separate reading light in a dark room.

Our X3 home screen and physical controls.

The X3's $69 campaign offer runs October 24–31. The store already has that price ahead of the main-sale window. The current gift selector includes a free Halloween Orange or Halloween Purple magnetic case.

X4 Classic: more screen, still buttons

XTEINK X4 Classic: $65.57 with 17% code Halloween on eligible $79 configurations; October 21–23 early-bird stand and case bundles.
Where to buy: XTEINK X4 Classic
Price checked: October 21, 2026.

The X4 Classic weighs about 68 grams. It keeps the physical controls and skips the front light. If you read with daylight or a lamp, it's the larger-screen option without the Pro's touch controls.

Selected color bundles in the October 21–23 early-bird offer include a free Base Stand and a choice of magnetic case. The Halloween case offer is limited to the first 3,000 eligible orders. If code Halloween applies to your $79 configuration, the 17% discount brings it to $65.57 before tax and shipping. Confirm the code applies to your selected bundle at checkout.

The Classic also joins the October 24–31 main sale. Compare the bundle's stand and case choices, not just the discount percentage.

Our X4 Classic with its home screen displayed.

X4 Pro: read after dark

XTEINK X4 Pro: $99 regular price; not part of the Halloween promotion. Mist Gray preorder shipping expected from October 28.
Where to buy: XTEINK X4 Pro
Price checked: October 21, 2026.

The X4 Pro pairs a 4.3-inch screen with an adjustable front light, touchscreen and physical buttons. You can tap or swipe through the interface, then switch to the buttons for page turns. The light is the reason to choose it over the other two if you read in a dim bedroom.

The Pro's regular price is $99; it is not part of the Halloween promotion. Mist Gray preorders are expected to start shipping October 28. Shipping dates vary by configuration.

Check the extras and shipping

Free shipping protection isn't free postage. The store's shipping banner sets a threshold of orders over $79, which a $69 X3 alone doesn't meet. Confirm the final shipping charge and the case or stand included with your selected bundle.

Our X3 and X4 Classic attached to the phone. The printed front sheets are still in place.

Bundles can differ between Amazon and the official XTEINK store. Compare the exact model, case and stand before choosing where to order.

XTEINK X3: $69; October 24–31 campaign offer. Halloween case choice.
Where to buy: XTEINK X3

XTEINK X4 Classic: $65.57 with 17% code Halloween on eligible $79 configurations; October 21–23 early-bird stand and case bundles.
Where to buy: XTEINK X4 Classic

XTEINK X4 Pro: $99 regular price; not part of the Halloween promotion. Mist Gray preorder shipping expected from October 28.
Where to buy: XTEINK X4 Pro
Price checked: October 21, 2026.

For the smallest carry, start with the X3. The Classic gives you more page space and the early-bird bundle; the Pro is the one to consider for touch controls and reading without an external light.
